title: MahoquotCatalogEnvelopeV1
description: Detached cryptographic signature envelope for Mahoquot model catalog manifest (v1)

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version, must equal 1 for v1 envelopes

catalog_version.description: Monotonic unsigned catalog version matching the signed catalog payload

key_id.description: Identifier of the Ed25519 key used to produce the signature

generated_at.description: Epoch timestamp in seconds when the envelope signature was generated

expires_at.description: Optional epoch timestamp in seconds after which the catalog envelope is considered expired
